reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly flags in Liquidate.sol::executeLiquidate() that liquidatorReward is computed using debtPosition.futureValue (borrow-token units) while assignedCollateral and debtInCollateralToken are in collateral-token units, leading to a negligible reward. This matches the vulnerability description’s root cause (unit/decimals mix-up), code path, impact (no incentive to liquidate -> bad debt), and specific fix (compute reward based on the collateral-denominated amount, i.e., use debtInCollateralToken). Fixing the audit’s issue would fix the described issue as well.
